traceability.notes: Story 010.1-DEV-CONFIGURABLE-PATTERNS is fully implemented. The valid-annotation-format rule now supports nested and flat configuration for story/requirement patterns and example strings, validates regex options with clear configuration errors, falls back safely to defaults for backward compatibility, exposes a JSON Schema that matches the specified options, and is documented with concrete configuration examples. Dedicated Jest tests tied to this story and its REQ IDs exercise valid configurations, invalid regex fallbacks, precedence between nested and flat settings, and error message customization, and all tests pass in the full test run.
